## Two judgement calls worth knowing

- **Float slack, `TOKEN_EPSILON = 1e-9`.** Exactly one token interval (1500/37 ms) landed on `0.9999999999999999` tokens, so the first test run refused a token that was mathematically there. The tolerance is in `config.py`, not buried in the bucket.
- **Gold refills twice as fast in tokens/second** (`burst` doubles, `refill_ms` fixed at 1500) — that is the only reading consistent with "the refill time stays 1500 ms".

`limiter/__init__.py` and `vendor/` untouched; stdlib only; docstrings on every public class and function. Open items: buckets never expire (the spec defines no expiry) and unrecognised tier names fall back to the standard burst.
